title: crisis_evaluate runs several full-packet walks per bundle per lane every tick
evidence:
core/crisis.odin:110: "bundle_class_queue :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, bi: u32, class: u16) -> u32 {"
core/crisis.odin:126: "bundle_lane_at_bound :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, bi: u32) -> bool {"
core/crisis.odin:138: "class_in_bundle_lane :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, bi: u32, lane: u8, class: u16) -> bool {"
core/crisis.odin:157-162: "for lane in u8(0)..<LANE_COUNT {\n\t\tif bundle_lane_count(state, cat, bi, lane) < bound { continue }\n\t\tif class_in_bundle_lane(state, cat, bi, lane, class) { return true }"
core/crisis.odin:208: "crisis_find_saturated_bundle :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, class: u16) -> (u32, u32, bool) {"
detail: bundle_class_queue, bundle_lane_at_bound (via bundle_lane_count), and class_in_bundle_lane each rescan all flow packets; crisis_bundle_saturated runs two of them per lane, and crisis_find_saturated_bundle loops every bundle. recommended_fix: Accumulate per-bundle per-class queue counts once per tick in a flow_step-built scratch (like drop_sites), or document the complexity bound at the call site.
